body: - **Step 7a (architectural guidelines)**: G-IO-1 deviation — `_read_keepalive_clone_path(tmpdir: Path) -> str` is hand-rolled independently in `python/larch/design/design_core.py`, `python/larch/implement/dispatch_commit_route.py`, and `python/larch/implement/step_7a.py`, each re-implementing `.larch-keepalive` KEY=value parsing instead of calling `larch.io.read_kv(path=..., key="CLONE_PATH", reject_symlink=True)` or reusing the existing, more robust `_read_keepalive_clone_path` in `python/larch/agents/_run_external.py` (already imported by `larch.agents.agents`; no import-cycle barrier — `design`/`implement` modules already import from `larch.agents` elsewhere in the codebase). Four independent implementations of the same lookup can now silently drift apart; the plan's own item 3 addresses this exact class of risk for the analogous Bash-side duplication with a structural byte-identity test, but leaves the Python-side duplication uncovered.
